sources.claim: Symantec reports RansomHub is very likely an updated and rebranded Knight line with significant code overlap.
MITRE says RansomHub operators may have purchased and rebranded Knight/Cyclops resources that share infrastructure, feature, and code overlaps.

curator_note: Modeled as derived_from through source-code and resource continuity, not shared operators; Symantec explicitly cautions against assuming Knight's creators run RansomHub.
confidence_reason: Symantec provides direct reverse-engineering comparison and MITRE corroborates the Knight/Cyclops overlap as a CTI knowledge-base claim.
